content: Yinni Gusunɔ u Isirelibɑ wɔrɑ ben yibɛrɛ be bɑ kɑ bu sikerenɛn nɔmɑn di. Mɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ sere n kɑ tɛ. Yosue u mɑɑ tɔkɔ kuɑ ɡem ɡem.
Yerɑ u Isirelibɑ kpuro sokusiɑ kɑ ben ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ ben wiruɡibu kɑ ben siri kowobu kɑ ben tɑbu sinɑmbu. Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛ wee nɑ tɔkɔ kuɑ ɡem ɡem.
I mɑɑ wɑ nɡe mɛ Gusunɔ bɛɛn Yinni u bwese ni i deemɑ mini kuɑ. Wiyɑ u kɑ bu tɑbu kuɑ bɛɛn sɔ̃ u bu kɑmiɑ.

Yen biru i wɑ nɡe mɛ tem mɛ sɑ mwɑ kɑ mɛ sɑ ǹ mwɑɑbu kpɑ, nɑ mu bɔnu kuɑ kɑ tɛtɛ, mɑ nɑ bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyere yeɡim wɛ̃. Tem mɛyɑ mu wɑ̃ɑ sɑɑ Yuudɛnin di sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ n kɑ ɡirɑri nim wɔ̃ku ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛditerɑnɛɔ, sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ.
Tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mɛ sɔɔ, Yinni Gusunɔ u koo bɛɛ bu ɡirɑ kpɑ ben tem mɛ, mu ko bɛɛɡim, nɡe mɛ win tii u ɡeruɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, i tɛmɑnɔ, i hɑniɑ koowo kpɑ i wɑ i woodɑ ye mɛm nɔɔwɑ ye Mɔwisi u yoruɑ tireru sɔɔ kpɑ i ku yen ɡɑɑ ɡɛɛrɑri bɑɑ fiiko.
I ku kɑ bwese tuku ni nu wɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ ɑrukɑwɑni bɔke i suɑnɑ. I ku yiirɑ i nin bũnu sɑ̃. I ku mɑɑ kɑ nin yĩsɑ bɔ̃re.
Adɑmɑ i n yɛ̃ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ tɔnɑwɑ i ko n kɑ mɑninɛ nɡe mɛ i sɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔ.
Domi u bwese dɑmɡinu ɡirɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔn di. Goo mɑɑ sɑri wi u kpĩɑ u yɔ̃rɑ bɛɛn wuswɑɑɔ sere kɑ ɡisɔ.
Bɛɛn tɔn turo u koo kpĩ u yibɛrɛ nɔrɔbu (1.000) ɡo, nɡe mɛ Gusunɔn tii u nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ, yèn sɔ̃ u rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛɛ tɑbu sɔɔ.
Yen sɔ̃ i de i nùn kĩɑ.
Ì n nùn biru kisi i kɑ bwese ni nu wɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ, i nin wɔndiɑbɑ suɑ kurɔbu kpɑ nin tii nu bɛɛɡibu suɑ kurɔbu,
sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, i n yɛ̃ mɑ u ǹ mɑɑ yibɛrɛ be ɡirɑmɔ. U koo dewɑ bɑ n sɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn yinɑ. Bɑ ko n bɛɛ wɑhɑlɑ mɔ̀ bɑ n nɔni sɔ̃ɔwɑ, kpɑ i ɡbisuku tem durom mɛni sɔɔ mɛ Gusunɔ bɛɛn Yinni u bɛɛ wɛ̃.
Ǹ n nɛn sɔ̃n nɑ, wee nɑ ɡɔɔ turɑ. I n yɛ̃ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ mɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛ ɡee ni u bɛɛ kuɑ, u ni kpuro yibiɑ mɑm mɑm. Bɑɑ nin teerɑ kun kɑm kue.
Mɛyɑ i n mɑɑ yɛ̃ nɡe mɛ u nɔɔ mwɛɛ ɡee ni yibiɑ mi, mɛyɑ u koo mɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye u ɡeruɑ kpuro ko. U koo bɛɛ ɡo mɑm mɑm tem durom mɛ sɔɔ mɛ u bɛɛ wɛ̃ mini.
Ì n win ɑrukɑwɑni ye kusiɑ ye u kɑ bɛɛ bɔkuɑ kpɑ i dɑ i n bwese tukunun bũnu yiirɑmmɛ i n sɑ̃ɑmɔ, sɑɑ yerɑ win mɔru koo se kpɑ i ɡbisuku tem durom mɛni sɔɔ.
Yosue u kɑ Isirelibɑ ɡɑri kuɑ
